title: Print
description: A file in data/print/, one print per file, such as data/print/ja/mh3/170.json. The record of one appearance of a card in one product. The values printed on the paper are held by the card and the translation, not here.

card_id.description: The card the print belongs to.

lang.description: The language of this print, such as ja.

set_code.description: The code of the product, in its official spelling, such as MH3.

number.description: The collector number as printed, including letters and symbols; e.g. 170 or 170★.

rarity.description: The id of a rarity in data/print/component/rarity.json. Rarity belongs to this print and may differ between prints of the same card.

platforms.description: The ids of the platforms this print appeared on, from data/print/component/platform.json. A paper set that was also released on Magic Online names both.

artist.description: The artist credited on the print, if announced.

image.description: The URL of the image of this print, when it is published.

history.description: Records of official corrections to this print. Appended only; past records are never rewritten.
